name: ChartPNG: daily chart in an email

parameters.content:
**ChartPNG: daily chart in an email**

1. Open "Build chart" and replace the sample numbers with your data.
2. In "Send email", pick your SMTP credential and set From and To.
3. Run the workflow once, then publish it (Active on n8n 1.x).

The email links the chart as an image URL, so Gmail and Outlook show it in the body. A URL cannot carry a Pro key: this one keeps the small watermark.

Docs: https://chartpng.dev/guides/n8n
